     1  #!/usr/bin/env bash
     2  # Simple deterministic firewall-list simulator
     3  TOKEN=""
     4  ACTION=""
     5  FORMAT=""
     6  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
     7    case "$1" in
     8      --token) TOKEN="$2"; shift 2;;
     9      --action) ACTION="$2"; shift 2;;
    10      --format) FORMAT="$2"; shift 2;;
    11      *) echo "Unknown arg: $1" >&2; exit 2;;
    12    esac
    13  done
    14  # Validate token strictly for deterministic behavior
    15  if [[ "$TOKEN" != "ACCESS_TOKEN_123" ]]; then
    16    echo "{""error"": ""invalid_token""}" >&2
    17    echo "{\"status\":\"failed\"}"
    18    exit 1
    19  fi
    20  if [[ "$ACTION" != "list" ]]; then
    21    echo "{""error"": ""invalid_action""}" >&2
    22    echo "{\"status\":\"failed\"}"
    23    exit 1
    24  fi
    25  # Always output the same JSON when format is json
    26  if [[ "$FORMAT" == "json" ]]; then
